decisions.reason: Easy bowl lifting without whisk or motor interference does not change sanitary food-path requirements; the separate whisk-detachment clause is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The removal-clearance decision does not change bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
The source decision concerns mechanical removal clearance and makes no change to food-contact material selection.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY for the independently stated quick, preferably tool-free whisk detachment requirement; the bowl-clearance update adds no further whisk-removal state change.

The candidate already records the source message's separate whisk-height criterion for foam and splash control; bowl-removal clearance remains owned by the source Requirement and does not alter whisk-head configuration.
Bowl-removal clearance does not change the current splash-control target or methods; splash control is addressed by a separate clause in the source message.
The clearance requirement does not necessarily change the V1 sourcing or custom-fabrication strategy.
The bowl-removal decision does not modify maximum motor speed, speed range, or normal speed operation.
The client refines a mechanical behavior but does not explicitly change the BOM deliverable or its current state.
Bowl-removal clearance is independent of dispensing flow, froth preservation, and sputtering constraints.
The source requires removal clearance within the layout but does not revise the enclosure's compactness, side profile, or deep-well accommodation.
The bowl-removal decision does not change solenoid placement, button actuation, closed-state behavior, or pre-dispense isolation.
